items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: Oh yeah. Man, I was definitely one.

ctx.x: I wanted to play with some of them that I never did play with them.
Were you a Gene Krupa fan?

Oh yeah. Man, I was definitely one. Music was in my family, my whole family, it’s very musical. And so my whole life I remember listening to Billie Holiday when I was almost a toddler. So I mean like Charlie Parker, my father bought all those records, all those 78 records and stuff, from Dial labels and stuff. So music, I came up in music. My mother was a singer and my grandmother, she was a minister of a church. She had a little Holy Rolly Church, a corner church, and she had five daughters, my aunts, and they…
